name: the fool
symbols: cliff edge one step away
white rose held loosely
small dog at the heel
bindle carrying almost nothing
face turned up, not down
themes: a beginning taken before readiness arrives
lightness chosen on purpose
faith placed in the step, not the landing
shadow: recklessness wearing freedom's clothes
refusing to look down until the ground decides for you
charge: what would you start if you were allowed to not know how it ends?
voice_note: gesture at the step not yet taken, and the lightness they keep postponing.

name: the magician
symbols: one hand up, one hand down
all four tools laid on the table
the sideways eight above the head
roses and lilies growing where he works
themes: everything needed is already on the table
will as the bridge between wanting and having
the moment of naming what you intend
shadow: performing capability instead of using it
the trick that impresses everyone but the trickster
charge: you have the tools. what is the sentence you have not said over them?
voice_note: point at the table, not the sky. the power in this one is close at hand and unclaimed.

name: the high priestess
symbols: a veil between two pillars
the scroll half-hidden in her lap
a thin moon at her feet
water beginning somewhere behind the curtain
themes: what is known but not yet said
the answer that arrives in stillness, not in asking
a threshold guarded by patience
shadow: hoarding the knowing to stay in control of it
calling avoidance intuition
charge: what do you already know that you are waiting for permission to know?
voice_note: lower the volume. this one is read in the pauses; ask less and leave the veil in place.

name: the empress
symbols: a cushioned throne in an open field
wheat ripe at her feet
a crown of stars worn casually
the river running unbothered behind her
themes: abundance that comes from tending, not forcing
the body as a place to live rather than a tool
making something grow by staying near it
shadow: caretaking as a way to never be the one cared for
smothering what needed weather to ripen
charge: what have you been feeding that has never once fed you back?
voice_note: warm, unhurried. speak of growing things and let them find who they have been watering.

name: the emperor
symbols: a stone throne with no cushion
armor worn under robes at home
rams' heads at every corner
a thin river barely surviving the mountains
themes: order built so nothing can shake again
authority accepted as a weight
the structure that protects and confines the same person
shadow: control mistaken for safety
ruling a kingdom no one asked to live in
charge: who taught you that if you sit down, everything falls?
voice_note: respect the armor before naming it armor. this one bruises if handled fast.

name: the hierophant
symbols: two fingers up, two folded
crossed keys at the feet
two petitioners kneeling
the institution's roof overhead
themes: the rules that raised you
belonging bought with obedience
the teacher between a person and their own knowing
shadow: outsourcing the conscience
staying in the pew because leaving means the family notices
charge: whose blessing are you still waiting for, and what has the wait cost?
voice_note: name the tradition kindly, then ask who it fits now. never mock what they were raised in.

name: the lovers
symbols: two figures unclothed and unhidden
an angel over both
the tree of fruit and the tree of flame
a mountain rising exactly between them
themes: a choice that defines by being chosen
being seen without the usual covering
the alignment of want and value, or the gap between them
shadow: choosing what soothes over what fits
keeping one foot out the door and calling it independence
charge: if both roads cost you something, which loss could you live inside?
voice_note: this one is a fork wearing romance's face. read the choice, not the couple.

name: the chariot
symbols: two sphinxes pulling against each other
armor decorated with moons
a city wall left behind
reins that are nowhere in the picture
themes: motion held together by sheer will
two wants harnessed to one direction
victory that requires not stopping
shadow: momentum as a way to avoid deciding
winning the race chosen at nineteen
charge: if you stopped moving, what would catch up with you?
voice_note: match their speed first, then ask where the chariot is actually pointed.

name: strength
symbols: a hand resting on a lion's jaw
no weapon anywhere
the sideways eight again, worn lightly
flowers where a leash would be
themes: gentleness applied to what could devour
the slow taming that force would ruin
courage that looks like calm
shadow: muzzling the animal instead of knowing it
being so composed no one notices the lion
charge: what in you have you been holding shut with a bare hand, and for how long?
voice_note: honor the composure, then ask what it costs to keep the mouth closed.

name: the hermit
symbols: a lantern holding one star
a staff that has taken years of weight
grey heights above the treeline
light lifted for someone not yet visible
themes: withdrawal with a purpose inside it
the answer that only comes when the room empties
carrying light without company
shadow: solitude hardened into hiding
waiting on the mountain for someone to climb up and ask
charge: is the retreat still a search, or has it become the address?
voice_note: quiet register. do not chase them down the mountain; set the lantern where they can see it.

name: wheel of fortune
symbols: a wheel turning without a hand on it
figures rising and falling at its rim
creatures in the corners, reading and waiting
the hub that does not move
themes: the turn that was never yours to schedule
luck as weather, not verdict
the still point at the center of the spinning
shadow: taking credit for the up and blame for the down
waiting for the wheel to decide what you already could
charge: which part of this was ever in your hands, and which part have you been gripping anyway?
voice_note: separate the turning from the person. relief hides in this one: not everything was their doing.

name: justice
symbols: scales held perfectly level
a sword upright, edge visible
a crown squared over steady eyes
the small foot emerging from the robe
themes: the accounting that has been postponed
cause meeting effect without cruelty
clarity as a form of mercy
shadow: keeping score as a way of keeping distance
demanding a verdict where an amends would do
charge: what would balance actually require of you — not of them, of you?
voice_note: even tone, no verdicts. hold the scales up and let them do their own weighing.

name: the hanged man
symbols: hung by one foot, unhurt
hands loose behind the back
a halo around an upside-down head
the rope tied by no visible hand
themes: the pause that is doing more than the motion did
seeing it from the reversed angle
surrender that is chosen, not suffered
shadow: martyrdom worn as identity
calling limbo patience because climbing down means choosing
charge: what does it look like from up there that you could not see standing?
voice_note: do not rush this one down. ask what the hanging is for, and who tied the knot.

name: death
symbols: a white rose on a black flag
the sun rising between two towers
a bishop pleading, a child offering flowers
armor that has no one inside it
themes: the ending already underway
what must be laid down for the next thing to have hands
the season, not the sentence
shadow: propping up the finished thing
grieving so loudly the door never gets opened
charge: what has already ended that you are still attending?
voice_note: never say the name like a threat. point at the sunrise between the towers.

name: temperance
symbols: water poured between two cups without spilling
one foot on land, one in the stream
a road running back toward the light
wings held still while the hands work
themes: the mixture that neither part could be alone
patience as an active craft
the middle path walked on purpose
shadow: diluting the self to keep every party comfortable
moderation as a fear of wanting
charge: what two things in your life are waiting for you to stop keeping them separate?
voice_note: steady, blending register. this one reads as repair; find what is being mixed.

name: the devil
symbols: chains loose enough to lift off
an inverted torch still burning
two figures grown small at the feet
the perch above them, occupied and bored
themes: the arrangement that was comfort before it was cage
appetite mistaken for identity
servitude with the door unlocked
shadow: blaming the chain instead of the neck that fits it
one more round of the thing that stopped working years ago
charge: the chain is loose. what would you have to feel if you lifted it off?
voice_note: no shame in the voice, ever. note how loose the chains hang and leave the lifting to them.

name: the tower
symbols: lightning striking the crown first
two figures leaping into open air
fire lit from outside the walls
the rock it was built on, unmoved
themes: the collapse of what was built too certain
truth arriving as demolition
the clearing disguised as catastrophe
shadow: rebuilding the same tower, faster this time
calling the strike bad luck instead of overdue
charge: what are you still standing in that has already been struck?
voice_note: do not soften it. name what cracked, then point at the ground it clears.

name: the star
symbols: water given back to the pool
one foot resting on the surface without sinking
eight stars over bare shoulders
the bird watching from the one tree
themes: what remains after the tower: quiet, undefended
hope without performance
replenishment as a slow act
shadow: staying at the pool forever because the world has weather
hope postponed into a someday that never gets a date
charge: what would you look like undefended — after the load is down, after the audience leaves?
voice_note: close quiet. no triumph. this one is permission, poured slowly.

name: the moon
symbols: a road with no figures on it
the dog and the wolf howling at the same light
the crayfish half out of the pool
two towers with nothing between them
themes: the hour when familiar things wear strange faces
fear as a landscape to be walked, not solved
what surfaces when the light is indirect
shadow: treating the 3am version of the story as the true one
staying in the shallows because the road is unlit
charge: which of your fears is a wolf, and which is just the dog, howling along?
voice_note: walk beside them in this one. name the strangeness as weather that passes with the hour.

name: the sun
symbols: a child riding bareback with arms open
sunflowers over a garden wall
a banner that hides nothing
light with no angle to it
themes: joy that requires no defense
the simplicity on the far side of complexity
being seen in full light and staying anyway
shadow: performing brightness to keep questions away
distrusting the good thing because it came easy
charge: when did you last let something be simply good, without auditing it?
voice_note: let warmth in the voice. the reading here is whether they can receive it without flinching.

name: judgement
symbols: the horn sounding over open graves
figures rising with their arms wide
a flag marked with the plain cross
mountains that no longer block the sound
themes: the call that has already been heard
rising to a life that fits the person you became
forgiveness as a door out of the coffin
shadow: hitting snooze on the calling for another decade
self-judgment so loud the horn cannot get through
charge: you have heard it already. what would answering actually change by friday?
voice_note: this one is a summons, not a scolding. read what is rising, never what is guilty.

name: the world
symbols: a wreath closed into a circle
the dancer holding two wands, not one
the four watchers now at ease
nothing left outside the frame
themes: the completion that was earned in chapters
the circle closing where it opened
arrival that includes everything it took
shadow: refusing to call it done so the next thing never has to start
finishing everyone's story but one's own
charge: what circle in your life is one honest gesture away from closed?
voice_note: settle the room. name what is complete and let the silence hold the wreath.
